LanguageData.PaWT_M30LDR.label: M30 Luftwaffe Drilling(R)
LanguageData.PaWT_M30LDR.description: The M30 Luftwaffe Drilling was a survival weapon issued to Luftwaffe pilots, comes with 2 barrels for 12 gauge shotgun shells and 1 rifle barrel, but instead of 9.3x74mmR, it use the more common .45-70 Government round which also pack quite a punch.
